charts.title: Mitigation changes warming; adaptation changes exposure and vulnerability
constraints: Keep mitigation, warming, hazard, exposure, vulnerability, adaptation, and residual risk distinct.
Do not infer national damages from this map.

charts.title: Assessed warming pathways are scenarios, not forecasts
constraints: Do not invent annual trajectories or probabilities.

charts.title: Mitigation levers act through different systems and time horizons
constraints: The matrix is a responsibility and dependency map, not a marginal-abatement-cost curve.
No lever receives an unsupported universal rank.

charts.title: Adaptation packages follow the risk and responsible system
constraints: Adaptation choices require local exposure and vulnerability evidence.
Global risk evidence is not a local project design.

charts.title: Residual risk remains under lower, central, and severe conditions
constraints: Cells are qualitative planning states, not damage estimates.
Severe stress tests are not assigned probabilities.

charts.title: Mitigate low and adapt high through staged delivery
constraints: The sequence is a robust-decision roadmap, not a national benefit-cost optimum.
Monitoring and revision gates remain explicit.

charts.title: Versioned robust-decision model contract
constraints: No integrated damage total is authorized.
Release requires scenario provenance, local exposure, adaptation response, validation, and residual-risk reporting.
